events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on this day in 1940 in Liverpool.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese was born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album'.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed their groundbreaking 'White Album'. A double LP that pushed boundaries and defied expectations.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away at the age of 45. He would have been 80 this year, having been born in 1946.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a significant artistic evolution for the Fab Four.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, music icon John Lennon tragically passed away at the age of 40. He would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: Thinking of John Lennon on the anniversary of his passing. His timeless music continues to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary British musician and cultural icon David Bowie was born on this day in 1947.

angles.name: Bowie's Starman Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true chameleon of rock whose influence is immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935 in Tupelo, Mississippi.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Celebrating the birth of a legend! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, forever the King of Rock 'n' Roll.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page was born on this day in 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound and one of rock's greatest guitarists.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart, CBE, was born on this day in 1945.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Heart
angles.copy: Raise a glass for Sir Rod Stewart, celebrating his 82nd birthday today! A true rock and roll icon with a career spanning decades.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of British ska band Madness, was born on this day in 1961.

angles.name: Nutty Boy Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing us classics and keeping us dancing for decades.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', was born on this day in 1956.

angles.name: Wherever He Lays His Hat
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth-voiced Paul Young! Still got that soulful touch.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary American singer, songwriter, and actress Dolly Parton was born on this day in 1946.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton! A true living legend and an inspiration to millions worldwide.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Lead singer of Take That and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow was born on this day in 1971 in Frodsham, Cheshire.

angles.name: Gary's Big Day
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to the brilliant Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, a true British music staple.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of international hits, was born on this day in 1950.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth and soulful Billy Ocean! Still 'Suddenly' making us feel good with his timeless tracks.

events.title: First Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction (1986)
events.blurb: On this day in 1986, the first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held at the Waldorf-Astoria in New York City.

angles.name: Rock Hall Inaugural
angles.copy: It was 41 years ago today that the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame held its first induction ceremony, honouring the pioneers of the genre.

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member and solo artist Mark Owen was born on this day in 1972 in Oldham, Lancashire.

angles.name: Mark's Milestone
angles.copy: Celebrating Mark Owen's 55th birthday! From Take That heartthrob to solo artist, a true pop talent.
